Controls K1-K7 hold, K7 identifying the state's group with the census manifold m003 (the owner's rule of 2026-10-06, first application: seven load-bearing inputs, each re-derived by own code). Predictions P1-P6 with priors (P4 generation-shaped 25%, P5 three 8%); PROVED if a class reads (-3, -3) in two routes at the same class; NEGATIVE (scoped to the generic classes read) if none is generation-shaped. No count read. 0 of 19.
